\[
3,\; -\frac{23}{3},\; -\frac{2}{23},\; -65,\; \frac{97}{13}

\[
3 \cdot \left(-\frac{23}{3}\right) \cdot \left(-\frac{2}{23}\right) \cdot (-65) \cdot \frac{97}{13} = -970
